title: Derived pro-etale tensor compositor
statement: Let X --f--> Y --g--> Z be schemes. Let A be a symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with monoidal closed structure and functorial flat resolutions, and suppose pro-etale inverse image preserves flat objects. If the canonical upperStarComp A f g is monoidal, then its total-left-derived compositor d : L(gf)^* ≅ Lg^* ⋙ Lf^* obeys μ_(gf)(M,N) ; (d_M ⊗ d_N) = d_(M⊗N) ; Lf^*(μ_g(M,N)) ; μ_f(Lg^*M,Lg^*N) for all unbounded derived objects M,N. Here μ is the published leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison and d is leftDerivedUpperStarComp. [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-comp] [def-weil-derived-tensor]

proof.text: Apply the adopted source-library generic left-derived tensor composition theorem and naturality for the monoidal ordinary upperStar compositor. Its composite derived isomorphism is definitionally leftDerivedUpperStarComp. Keep the generic tensor maps as explicit parameters with comparison equalities so the kernel need not unfold the derived categories. Express the result in native component form using leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso and the two curried tensor maps, so coefficient specialization uses the same interface as the target.

theorem leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_comp
    [NatTrans.IsMonoidal (upperStarComp A f g).inv]
    (K M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology R) A)) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp A f g).hom.app (((derivedTensor A R).obj K).obj M) ≫
        L((f)^*[A]).map (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso A g K M).hom ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso A f (L((g)^*[A]).obj K)
          (L((g)^*[A]).obj M)).hom =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso A (f ≫ g) K M).hom ≫
        ((derivedTensor A T).map ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp A f g).hom.app K)).app
          (L((f ≫ g)^*[A]).obj M) ≫
        ((derivedTensor A T).obj (L((f)^*[A]).obj (L((g)^*[A]).obj K))).map
          ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp A f g).hom.app M)
